readings.commitment: Autocracy's stable form is hereditary monarchy: succession by blood removes the fight over the throne from every reign except the ones it ruins
readings.delta: Suppression of succession contests by birth rule; beneficiary is dynastic continuity and its court; victim set is talent outside the line; extractiveness routinized through tax-farming permanence

readings.commitment: Autocracy's crisis form is the junta: officers ruling as a committee, legitimated by emergency and the claim that only the army stands above faction
readings.delta: Suppression of civilian politics wholesale; beneficiary is the officer corps and its budgets; victim set is parties, unions, and the displaced civilian order; extractiveness administered by the institution that enforces it

readings.commitment: Autocracy's modern form is personalist: one ruler above party, army, and law, governing through fear, patronage, and the destruction of every rival institution
readings.delta: Suppression of all institutional checks including the autocrat's own party; beneficiary is the ruler and the clan; victim set is everyone at the ruler's pleasure including yesterday's allies; extractiveness arbitrary and maximal

readings.commitment: Autocracy's organized form is the single party: a disciplined organization monopolizing politics, with succession, ideology, and careers managed inside the apparatus
readings.delta: Suppression of outside competition with inside management; beneficiary is the nomenklatura as a class; victim set is non-members and inner-party losers; extractiveness institutionalized through the cadre system

readings.commitment: Personalist rule cannot retire: authority lodged in one biography has no successor, and every personalist regime faces Weber's problem of routinizing what dies with the man
readings.delta: Suppression of institutional succession paths; beneficiary is the ruler's irreplaceability claim; victim set is regime continuity past one lifespan; extractiveness of the system mortgaged to one mortality

readings.commitment: Personalist rule survives by coup-proofing: parallel security forces, rotated commanders, divided services — the army weakened against its own state to keep it weak against the palace
readings.delta: Suppression of the military's coordination capacity; beneficiary is palace security; victim set is military effectiveness against real enemies; extractiveness of defense capacity traded for ruler safety

readings.commitment: The personality cult destroys the ruler's own information: when praise is mandatory, reports are flattery, and the autocrat governs a country that exists only in his briefings
readings.delta: Suppression of true signals by the incentive to please; beneficiary is short-run sycophants; victim set is decision quality and eventually the ruler; extractiveness of accurate information taxed to extinction

readings.commitment: Theocracy's juridical form is clerical guardianship: the qualified jurist rules pending the awaited perfection, Iran's velayat-e faqih the modern instance of rule as religious trusteeship
readings.delta: Suppression of secular sovereignty claims; beneficiary is the guardian jurist and the clerical estate; victim set is republican institutions in conflict with guardianship; extractiveness legitimated as trust administration

readings.commitment: Theocracy's archaic form is divine kingship: the ruler not God's interpreter but God's presence, pharaoh and emperor as the hinge between cosmos and realm
readings.delta: Suppression of any standpoint outside the sacred ruler; beneficiary is the king-god and temple economy; victim set is the profane subject without appeal; extractiveness cosmologized as offering

readings.commitment: Theocracy's textual form is scriptural law: governance as application of revealed code by trained interpreters, the state subordinate to a law it did not make and cannot amend
readings.delta: Suppression of legislative sovereignty (law is found, not made); beneficiary is the interpreting class; victim set is statutory innovation against the code; extractiveness bounded and warranted by the text's readers

readings.commitment: Customary rule's political form is chieftaincy: authority held by descent groups and exercised through council and consensus, the office older than any of its holders
readings.delta: Suppression of upstart authority claims; beneficiary is recognized lineages; victim set is junior lines and strangers; extractiveness of tribute moderated by redistribution duty

readings.commitment: Customary rule's economic core is land: tenure by community membership and use, not title — land as relationship that markets and registries misdescribe by design
readings.delta: Suppression of alienability itself; beneficiary is the community across generations; victim set is would-be buyers and mortgagors; extractiveness of speculative capture blocked by inalienability

readings.commitment: Customary rule's judicial form is the elders' moot: disputes settled by discussion toward reconciliation, the remedy aimed at restoring relations rather than declaring winners
readings.delta: Suppression of adversarial finality; beneficiary is community cohesion; victim set is bright-line rights claimants; extractiveness of conflict absorbed into compensation and ritual

readings.commitment: Direct democracy's working model is Swiss: initiative and referendum woven into routine governance, the people as a standing fourth branch that any law may have to face
readings.delta: Suppression of purely representative finality; beneficiary is mobilizable publics and consensus politics; victim set is swift parliamentary action; extractiveness of legislation conditioned on survivable popularity

readings.commitment: Direct democracy's communal form is the town meeting: the assembled neighbors as the legislature, self-government at the scale where everyone can be heard
readings.delta: Suppression of delegation at micro scale; beneficiary is attending residents; victim set is the non-attending and the issue too large for the hall; extractiveness governed by those who show up

readings.commitment: Direct democracy's shadow is the plebiscite: the ruler's question, the ruler's timing, a yes-or-no that converts acclamation into mandate — participation as the autocrat's notary
readings.delta: Suppression of deliberation behind participation's form; beneficiary is the question's framer; victim set is the alternatives never on the ballot; extractiveness of consent manufactured by binary design

readings.commitment: The initiative lets a hundred thousand signatures amend the constitution: agenda power held by publics, not parliaments — the system's engine and its wildcard
readings.delta: Suppression of elite agenda monopoly; beneficiary is organized movements of any stripe; victim set is gatekeeping institutions; extractiveness of constitutional change opened at signature price

readings.commitment: The referendum threat made Swiss consensus: any excluded force can sink a law at the ballot, so everyone is brought inside first — the magic formula as referendum-proofing
readings.delta: Suppression of majoritarian winner-take-all; beneficiary is permanent coalition inclusion; victim set is adversarial alternation; extractiveness of opposition converted to co-government

readings.commitment: Direct democracy can vote on the few: the minaret ban wrote a restriction into the constitution by initiative — popular sovereignty's collision with rights, on the record
readings.delta: Suppression of counter-majoritarian shelter at the constitutional level; beneficiary is the initiating majority; victim set is the targeted minority; extractiveness of rights exposed to the ballot
